subject: Quick follow-up + schedule: CloudHeart throughput deep-dive and capacity call
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Bret Johnson <bret.johnson@cloudheart.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + schedule: CloudHeart throughput deep-dive and capacity call

Hi Bret —

Thanks again for a constructive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next step:

Recap:
- Primary use case: document ingestion + semantic search across internal KBs (expecting spikes from bulk import jobs).
- Target scale: demo indicated ~150–300 rps for peak batch ingestion; team wants target production of ~200 rps steady with occasional spikes.
- Latency sensitivity: p95 generation/embedding lookup target <= 300ms; some endpoints can tolerate higher latency.
- Data controls: CloudHeart prefers an isolated pool (dedicated) and needs SOC2 evidence for audit.

Next step: technical deep-dive + dedicated capacity sizing call to lock throughput/latency targets, model variant suggestions, and any quantization preferences. Proposed agenda (45–60m):
1) Walk through traffic profile and sample payloads (10m)
2) Throughput/latency targets + failure modes (10m)
3) Dedicated pool sizing options and autoscaling patterns (15m)
4) Pre-call intake / next steps and owners (10m)

Proposed times (PDT):
- Mon Jun 7, 10:00–11:00
- Tue Jun 8, 09:00–10:00
- Wed Jun 9, 13:00–14:00

If those don't work, share a couple slots that do. Also: who from CloudHeart should join? (infra/ops, engineering, procurement?)

I'll attach a short capacity intake form to capture traffic shapes ahead of the call — filling that out will help us prepare a concrete sizing recommendation.

Thanks,
Evelyn
